services.name: Clay Classes
services.desc: Do you have a question about an item(s) of pottery that you believe was manufactured in the East Liverpool Pottery District? Use this form and a Museum staff member will contact you about your item. Currently this form does not support the upload of images. We will request images in our reply email. Alternatively, you can email us directly and upload your images, including the trademark or manufacturer’s mark on the bottom of the piece, to potteryquestions@gmail.com. The East Liverpool Pottery District covers the area approximately 20 miles around East Liverpool Ohio.
